description: Finish a login started with the login tool: waits up to 25 seconds for the approval, then answers. While it is pending, keep calling it on your own (do not ask the user whether to continue) until it completes or expires. "pending": the user has not approved yet, call again. "completed": returns a new Hey Anon API key (named "MCP <date>"); when the account had no wallets, an EVM, a Solana and a TON wallet were created first. Save the key immediately as the X-API-Key header of this MCP server in the client config and reconnect; it is shown only once and the login_id cannot be reused. "denied" / "expired": start again with login. Clients with the io.modelcontextprotocol/tasks extension get an MCP task instead and poll tasks/get.

login_id.description: login_id returned by the login tool

name: login_status
title: Finish Hey Anon login
